document: ET-8b — THE ACCUMULATION LIMB, on two independent 300s. gen1 > gen0 at no extra cost, on both seeds.
the_§4_cell_this_lands_in: docs/et8b-loop-gates.md §4 row 1: 'gen1 > gen0, interval excludes zero, at <= gen0's cost' -> ACCUMULATION — the frontier moved twice; 8b's claim.

INSTRUMENT_NAMED_BY_HASH.rule: 理 §3: a result artefact names its instrument by hash — model id, adapter md5, task-set signature — or its downstream claims are marked unauditable. Applied here to this result first.

task_set_signatures_sha256_16.method: sha256 over each task's program|symptom|bug_region, task files sorted

head_md5.note: all six verified identical on box A and box B before the runs — one matching hash proves a copy happened, not that the arms are identical

INSTRUMENT_NAMED_BY_HASH.disjointness: measured, not assumed: v3 vs v3c signature overlap 0, v3 vs v3rep overlap 0. No head has seen any problem it was evaluated on.

THE_ACCUMULATION_LIMB.reported_seed_by_seed: NOT POOLED. 理: reported seed by seed, never pooled without a sentence saying so. These are two independent replications, not one 600.

THE_COST_LIMB_because_§4_requires_at_or_.controller_cost: IDENTICAL BY CONSTRUCTION. gen0 and gen1 run the same architecture — three per-decision heads, same candidate counts — so head inference cancels in this pair. The comparison needing a compute argument is G-vs-base, not gen1-vs-gen0.
THE_COST_LIMB_because_§4_requires_at_or_.verdict: gen1 costs the same or less. The §4 condition is met.

THE_OTHER_TWO_LIMBS.base_rates: 20.7% and 21.0% on the two independent sets, against the 15-24% band registered before either was computed (docs/et8b-ind73-base-prediction.md).

🔴_THE_n75_SCREEN_SAID_THE_OPPOSITE_AND_T.screen: gen1 vs gen0 on 75 held-out tasks: -2.7 [-12.0, +6.7], p = 0.77
🔴_THE_n75_SCREEN_SAID_THE_OPPOSITE_AND_T.what_I_did_with_it: refused to file it in §4's 'one-shot' cell. docs/et8b-reading-note.md, committed c2652fe BEFORE the screen's number existed, fixed the reason: an 18.7-point-wide interval on n=75 cannot separate one-shot from a small real increment.
🔴_THE_n75_SCREEN_SAID_THE_OPPOSITE_AND_T.how_it_reconciles: seed 73's +5.7 lies INSIDE the screen's interval [-12.0, +6.7]. seed 47's +9.7 lies just outside it. So the screen is consistent with one replication and marginally inconsistent with the other — which is what an underpowered screen looks like, not a contradiction.
🔴_THE_n75_SCREEN_SAID_THE_OPPOSITE_AND_T.the_point: had the screen been filed as 'one-shot', two independent 300s would now be contradicting a published reading. The pre-registration is what prevented that, and it is worth more than the result it protected.

WHAT_IS_NOT_CLAIMED: Not a third generation. gen2 is unmeasured and nothing here says accumulation continues.
One model (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct), one environment family (v3), one budget (12 actions across up to 3 decisions).
Two synthetic environments sharing one harness whose blind spots would be invisible to both — the bound 8a already carries.

gen1's heads were fitted on 2,824 cross-fitted rows against gen0's 4,052. gen1 had LESS training data, so the comparison is conservative in gen1's favour — but it is not a matched-data comparison and is not offered as one.
